Show Up & Play Mahjong
Arrive early. There will be food. There will be drinks. There will be Mahjong — and yes, it is complimentary, so please do not ask. This is your window to mingle, settle in, and mentally prepare for what is about to happen. We recommend arriving on time. We know you won't. The Mahjong will be waiting.

The Point of No Return
This is it. Ten years, one corgi, and a considerable amount of convincing later — we are doing this. Together with our families, we invite you to witness the moment it becomes official, permanent, and legally complicated to undo. The Salisbury Room, The Peninsula Hong Kong. Please be seated. Please don't cry before we do.
P.S. Take pictures of Christy. Take many. She has dressed up, she is wearing makeup, and there is no historical precedent suggesting this will ever happen again.
19:45 – 23:00
The Part You Actually Came For
A traditional Chinese wedding banquet, because some things should never be compromised. The wine list has been personally curated by Mitchell, who spent an unreasonable amount of time on this and would like you to notice. There will be warmth, gratitude, joy, and multiple courses. Pace yourself. It's a long night and the wine is very good.
Our Story

A Timeline Nobody Requested

"Ten years. One corgi. Zero regrets (probably)."

We met at university — back when the biggest decisions were which lectures to skip and which instant noodles to buy. It was not love at first sight. Christy made good decisions. Mitchell made Christy's decisions slightly more interesting.

What followed was a decade of building a life together — new cities, new jobs, one very opinionated corgi — held together by the kind of love that doesn't announce itself loudly, but simply refuses to leave.

We grew up, more or less. We won't pretend every day was poetic. Some days were very much about whose turn it was to do the dishes. But we kept showing up for each other, through the mundane and the meaningful, and somewhere along the way it became the best thing either of us ever accidentally did.

After a decade of practice runs, we decided to make it permanent. This is that wedding. You're invited. Please come — we've already paid for your dinner.

A Quick Introduction

Our Child

Meet Chambolle. He is a Pembroke Welsh Corgi. He is also, legally and emotionally, our child — and we will not be taking questions.

Named after the village in Burgundy that started one of our most expensive hobbies. (The wine, not the dog. Though honestly, similar budget.)

He did not attend the engagement. He was not consulted on the venue. He has opinions about the seating plan that we have chosen to ignore.

He will not be at the wedding. He is devastated. We are not sorry.

Getting There

The Peninsula Hong Kong

The venue is The Salisbury Room at The Peninsula Hong Kong, Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon. It is one of Hong Kong's most iconic hotels and has been standing since 1928, so it should not be difficult to find. We believe in you.

Venue The Salisbury Room at The Peninsula Hong Kong
Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
Apple Maps Get Directions

MTR: Tsim Sha Tsui Station (East Tsim Sha Tsui exit J) — 3 min walk. This is the easiest option. Use it.

Taxi: Tell the driver 半島酒店, Tsim Sha Tsui. If you attempt to pronounce it in English, results may vary.

Questions & Answers

Doors open at 17:00. We recommend arriving between 17:00 and 18:00 — there are drinks, there is Mahjong, and frankly it's a better use of your time than circling the lobby looking confused. The ceremony begins at 18:30 sharp. The Salisbury Room is inside The Peninsula Hotel. Follow the signs. You'll be fine. Probably.

12 September 2026. That is two months before the wedding, which we consider more than reasonable. This deadline exists because Christy is personally managing the seating plan, the catering, and approximately one thousand other things simultaneously — and she would very much like to know if you're coming before she loses her mind entirely. Please do not make her chase you. RSVP directly on this page.

Glad you asked. Mitchell has been waiting for this question. For red, he secured an auction lot from the Hospices de Beaune 2024 — one of Burgundy's most prestigious annual sales — so yes, it will be special, and yes, he will probably mention it. For white, the selection is from his favourite label, 00 Wine — a place close to his heart, he went for the harvest there himself. If you have a preference or allergy, note it in your RSVP. If you have opinions about his choices, keep them to yourself.

He will not. The Peninsula operates a strict no-Corgi policy, a decision we find deeply questionable but have chosen not to litigate. Chambolle has been informed. He has opinions. He will be at home in his little castle, deeply unimpressed, waiting for stinky treats upon our return. He sends his love, conditionally.

Short answer: only if you're named on the invitation. The venue has a capacity, Christy has a seating plan, Mitchell has a wine order, and none of these things have room for surprise guests. If your invitation includes a plus-one, you'll be able to add their name when you RSVP. If you're unsure, ask us directly.
